auth.change_pin.help: Prove it's you with your current PIN, then pick a new one (4–8 digits, not used by anyone else). You'll sign in again with the new PIN.
auth.error.locked: Too many attempts — try again shortly
auth.error.unavailable: Sorry — the till can't reach its own data right now, so it can't sign you in. Close the app completely and open it again. If that doesn't help, report the problem so we can look into it.
auth.exit_to_os.help: Enter a manager PIN to leave this screen and return to the OS desktop.
auth.exit_to_os.kiosk_appliance: This till is a dedicated kiosk appliance with no OS desktop to exit to — nothing changed. Use the window mode setting in Settings instead.
auth.exit_to_os.not_confirmed: The till's window was asked to close, but hasn't confirmed yet — check the till's screen. The exit was recorded.
auth.exit_to_os.unavailable: This till's window can't be reached, so it can't be closed from here. Nothing changed.

elevation.summary.backup_now: Create a new local backup now.
elevation.summary.backup_restore: Replace ALL current data with backup %s (the replaced data is kept in the backups folder). The till applies it on the next restart.
elevation.summary.browsing_mode: Change how the sell screen browses items to "%s".
elevation.summary.buttons_delete_item: Delete “%s” from the catalog. This removes it everywhere, not just the sell screen.
elevation.summary.buttons_move: Move quick button %s next to its neighbour.
elevation.summary.buttons_remove: Remove quick button %s from the sell screen.
elevation.summary.buttons_unhide: Show “%s” on the sell screen again.
elevation.summary.buttons_unhide_all: Show every hidden item on the sell screen again.
elevation.summary.cancel_order: Cancel order %s. It is removed from open orders and this cannot be undone.
elevation.summary.catalog_import_barcode: Stop pre-ticking "derive barcodes from SKU" on catalog imports.
Pre-tick "derive barcodes from SKU" on catalog imports.
elevation.summary.catalog_pre_pack_unit_: Stop showing unit prices on pre-packed item labels.
Show unit prices on pre-packed item labels.
elevation.summary.data_archive_purge: Permanently delete this archived batch. This cannot be undone and it can no longer be restored afterwards.
elevation.summary.data_archive_restore: Move this archived batch's sales, shifts and invoices back into the working till.
elevation.summary.data_catalog_cleanup: Permanently remove %d inactive product(s) that were never sold.
elevation.summary.data_catalog_cleanup_a: Permanently remove %d product(s) that were never sold, including active ones.
elevation.summary.data_customer_erase: Permanently erase this customer's personal data (name, phone, email) — reference %s. Their sales are kept, anonymised.
elevation.summary.data_reset_transaction: Archive all sales, shifts and invoices and restart receipt numbering. The catalog, users, settings and archived reports are kept. Restorable from Settings → Data management until the till trades again.
elevation.summary.dismiss_pending_base_p: Dismiss the pending %s base plugin without installing it.
elevation.summary.display_mode: Set this till's device profile to %s.
elevation.summary.enrol_check_plan: Ask the cloud now whether this shop is on a paid plan.
elevation.summary.enrol_claim_code: Generate a new store-claim code and QR link.
elevation.summary.enrol_now: Attempt to register this till with the marketplace now.
elevation.summary.enrol_pair: Pair this till with a shop in the cloud, replacing its current cloud connection.
elevation.summary.enrol_terms: Accept the Universal Till cloud service terms for this shop.
elevation.summary.eod_settings_disabled: Turn off the automatic end-of-day report.
elevation.summary.eod_settings_enabled: Turn on the automatic end-of-day report, scheduled for %s.
elevation.summary.idle_lock: Set the idle auto-lock timeout to %s.
elevation.summary.keep_demo_item: Keep sample item %s as a permanent catalog item.
elevation.summary.keep_demo_promo: Keep sample promo code %s as a permanent promo code.
elevation.summary.kiosk_idle_reset: Set the self-order kiosk idle-reset window to %s.
elevation.summary.kiosk_payment_mode: Set the self-order kiosk payment mode to %s.
elevation.summary.payments_default: Set the preferred payment method to %s.
elevation.summary.payments_fee: Set the %s payment fee to %s%% plus %s fixed per transaction.
elevation.summary.permission_revoke: Revoke the "%s" permission from the %s role.
elevation.summary.remove_demo_data: Permanently remove all untouched sample data (catalogue items, customers and promo codes).
elevation.summary.report_retention: Change the report retention mode to %s.
elevation.summary.staff_languages: Set the languages shown to staff to: %s
elevation.summary.store_save: Save changes to the store's currency, country, region or tax rate.
elevation.summary.subscription_check_now: Ask Universal Till now whether this shop's subscription was renewed.
elevation.summary.subscription_panel: Renew or change this shop's plan.
elevation.summary.sync_promote: Promote this till to a standalone main till, ending sync with its current main till.
permissions.action_desc.audit: Read the audit trail (who changed what, and when), including the reasons given for cash adjustments.
permissions.action_desc.cash_adjustment: Take cash out of the drawer (a payout, or a skim to the safe when closing a shift) without a manager PIN. Without this, taking cash out asks for a manager's PIN; paying cash in never does.
permissions.action_desc.catalog_manageme: Add and edit items, categories, modifiers and the quick buttons on the sale screen.
permissions.action_desc.data_management: Back up and restore data, and clean up or reset stored data. Each of these still asks for a PIN.
permissions.action_desc.eod_report: Run, print and export the end-of-day report.
permissions.action_desc.fiscal_tse_overr: Owner-level fiscal decisions: keep selling for a limited time while the signing device (TSE) is down, and confirm or remove a fiscal device by hand.
permissions.action_desc.import_export: Import products and other data from a file, such as an export from your previous till system.
permissions.action_desc.issue_reporting: Send a problem report to support, with an optional screen recording.
permissions.action_desc.permission_manag: Open this page and change what each role may do. Always on for super admins.
permissions.action_desc.personal_display: Choose your own theme and sale-screen layout. They follow you to every till in the shop and replace the shop's choice while you're signed in.
permissions.action_desc.plugin_managemen: Install, set up, update and remove plugins, and install app updates.
permissions.action_desc.refund: Refund a sale without a manager PIN. Without this, a refund asks for a manager's PIN.
permissions.action_desc.reports: See sales reports, invoices and the back-office view.
permissions.action_desc.settings: Change the till's settings and shop setup: receipts, printers, tables, kitchen stations, languages and more.
permissions.action_desc.stock_location_m: Set up your shop's locations and the registers in them.
permissions.action_desc.stock_management: Open Stock, receive deliveries and adjust stock counts.
permissions.action_desc.sync_management: Connect this till to the other tills in your shop, approve pairing requests and manage sync.
permissions.action_desc.tax_code_managem: Create and edit the tax codes and rates your items use.
permissions.action_desc.user_management: Add staff accounts, set PINs, change roles and switch accounts on or off.
permissions.action_desc.void_comp_waste: Take a priced item off the basket as a void, comp or waste without a manager PIN, and see the shrinkage figures in Reports.
permissions.action_desc.worker_allocatio: Record tip and service-charge payouts to staff in Reports.
permissions.error.cloud_role: This role is managed in my.universaltill.com. Change it there.
permissions.intro: Only a super admin can grant or revoke what each role is allowed to do. Every change is recorded in the audit trail.
permissions.lockout_error: Can't revoke this — it would lock every super admin out of this page.
permissions.lockout_hint: Always granted — revoking this would lock every super admin out of this page.
permissions.title: Permissions
shifts.close_success_with_skim: Shift closed. Expected: %s, Actual: %s, Variance: %s, Skim: %s, New float: %s
shifts.count_protocol_hint: How many of each coin and note are in the drawer. Leave empty to skip.
shifts.formula: Expected = opening cash + net cash payments + adjustments. Variance = counted − expected.
shifts.opening_carried: carried over from the last close
shifts.skim_formula: New float = counted − skim. A skim never changes the expected cash.
shifts.skim_hint: moved to the safe at close
shifts.skim_manager_pin_hint: Skimming cash to the safe requires manager approval, same as any other payout.
